statisticsMethod: nearest-rank p50/p90/p95; means calculated over valid numeric values; no sum of percentiles

sources.mcpPercentileMethod: Linear interpolation at (n - 1) * p, rounded to integer ms; verified in src/lib/mcp/stats.ts at 0433518.

limitations: PostHog complete voice-turn observations are from 15–17 September 2026 Europe/Zurich, not an October baseline.
Only three measured voice sessions; none in prod; percentiles are descriptive.
All 41 turn-level TTS provider labels say ElevenLabs, while correlated audio metadata says gradium/websocket.
max_ms includes preparation and memory waits, not pure upstream LLM duration.
STT duration is not a measured physical speech-end-to-final interval.
MCP exposes four aggregate/metadata tools, no raw traces or active settings; its turn summary reads legacy turn_latencies and returned zero samples.
MCP percentiles use linear interpolation; PostHog samples in this report use nearest rank. Do not pool their raw aggregate values.
Recorded costs exclude any amount missing from failed cost lookups.
Saved turn identities are pseudonyms S1/S2/S3; no transcript, real session ID, or tester label is retained.
Hands-free input and interruption were added in 0433518 during the audit; the 41 historical turns are PTT, not a measured hands-free pilot.
